items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: by the good grace of the Colonel... you were allowed by the Colonel to become attached to the band... And now, getting back to why I was allowed to come to 110th Street, because this friend of mine who was a private was a friend of the Colonel's... And the Colonel just said okay

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you, the Army band, the Army had authorized bands which consisted of 28 pieces and a director who was an officer, an officer. He wasn't a Lieutenant. He was just a step below a Lieutenant. Funny how these things escape you. Well, anyway, so we were all attached. When you came into the regiment, by the good grace of the Colonel, if you were drafted as just a soldier and you were put in a company, like whatever company, you were Company M, Company L, Company K, and you made it known that you were a…
